name: Eplény (Hungary)
description: White field with a blue horizontal stripe along the top edge and a red stripe along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Eplény (a red and blue shield with a bird, crossed tools and a Hungarian shield, with a helm, a crest and red, yellow and blue mantling) above the name EPLÉNY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Eplény arms with helm, crest and mantling
